options.text: A Workflow which is launched every time an Event is generated; used to debug Events
The Event Log which lists all Events that have been generated
The method used in server side scripts to generate Events and pass parameters
A table containing a record for every Event known to the ServiceNow system which allows ServiceNow to react when Events are generated

questions.explanation: The Event Registry is a table containing a record for every Event known to the ServiceNow system, which allows ServiceNow to react when Events are generated. Each registry entry defines the event name, firing table, and what should happen when the event fires (Script Actions, Notifications). It is not a workflow, log, or generation method.

questions.stem: Identify the ways an application can respond to an Event generated by the gs.eventQueue() method: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Applications can respond to events via: (B) Email Notifications (configured to trigger on specific events) and (D) Script Actions (server-side scripts that execute when an event fires). Client Scripts (A) and UI Policies (E) are client-side and don't respond to events. Scheduled Jobs (C) run on timers, not event triggers.

questions.stem: Is it possible to change an application’s scope?

options.text: Yes, but only from global scope to private scope
Yes, but only from private scope to global scope

questions.explanation: It is not possible to change an application's scope after creation. The scope (Global or private with a specific namespace prefix) is permanently set when the application is created. This is by design — changing scope would break all references, ACLs, and cross-scope access configurations that depend on the namespace.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about g_scratchpad? (Choose two.)

options.text: Used to push information from the server to the client
Does not exist on the mobile platform
Has default properties passed by client-side scripts

questions.explanation: About g_scratchpad: (A) it is used to push information from the server to the client — TRUE (Display Business Rules populate it for Client Scripts), and (B) it does not exist on the mobile platform — TRUE (mobile has limited client-side API support). g_scratchpad has no constructors or methods (C) — it's a simple key-value object. Properties are set by server-side scripts, not client-side (D).

questions.stem: Client-side scripts manage what?
questions.explanation: Client-side scripts manage Forms and Form Fields. They control the user interface experience including field visibility, mandatory status, validation messages, and dynamic form behavior. Client Scripts and UI Policies are the primary client-side scripting mechanisms. Server-side scripts handle database/backend (A), and access control is managed by ACLs.

questions.stem: When debugging Email Notifications, what must you check on a user record? (Choose two.)

options.text: The Email field must have a valid value.
The user must not be locked out.
The First name and Last name fields must have values.

questions.explanation: When debugging Email Notifications, check on the user record: (A) Active must be true (inactive users don't receive notifications) and (B) the Email field must have a valid value (no email address means no delivery). Lockout status (C) doesn't affect email delivery, name fields (D) aren't required for delivery, and delegation (E) is unrelated to notification delivery.

questions.stem: When crafting a scoped application that contains flow actions, what is the application called?
questions.explanation: A Spoke is a scoped application containing flow actions dedicated to a specific application or integration. Spokes package Flow Designer actions, subflows, and related content for reuse. When an application contains flow actions as its primary content, it is called a Spoke. Bundles group multiple spokes together.

questions.stem: Which are reasons an application could be developed on the ServiceNow platform? (Choose three.)

options.text: It needs workflow to manage processes.
It uses forms extensively to interact with data.

questions.explanation: Reasons an application could be developed on ServiceNow: (A) needs workflow to manage processes — TRUE (Flow Designer, workflows), (B) requires reporting capabilities — TRUE (built-in reporting engine), (C) uses forms extensively — TRUE (core ServiceNow strength). Low-level programming libraries (D) are not supported, and multimedia features (E) are not a core platform strength.

questions.stem: Once an application is ready to share, which of the following methods of publishing are supported by ServiceNow? (Choose three.)

options.text: Publish to a local USB device

questions.explanation: Supported publishing methods: (A) Publish to an application repository (instance or team repository), (C) Publish to the ServiceNow Store (marketplace distribution), and (D) Publish to an Update Set (for manual transfer between instances). Publishing to local drives (B), spreadsheets (E), or USB devices (F) are not supported publishing methods.

questions.stem: What is required to link a ServiceNow application to a Git repository? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: To link a ServiceNow application to a Git repository, you need: (D) Password (or token for authentication), (E) User name (for authentication), and (F) URL (the Git repository address). Application name (C) is not separately required. ACL (B) is not a Git linking requirement. URI (A) and URL (F) could be confused but URL is the standard field name.

questions.stem: Which business requirements and process(es) should be documented as part of the application development plan? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: Business requirements to document: (B) Business problem (what to solve), (C) Process steps (the workflow), (D) Users/stakeholders (who's involved), and (G) Data input/output (data flows). Available licenses (A), database capacity (E), and project schedule (F) are implementation concerns, not core business process documentation items.

questions.stem: Which objects are used as part of the client-side scripting API? (Choose two.)
When creating application tables, a user role is automatically added to the table record. Which other role does an application typically have?
questions.explanation: When creating application tables, a user role is automatically added. The other role an application typically has is an Application Admin role. This admin role grants elevated permissions for managing the application's configuration, data, and settings beyond what the user role provides.

questions.stem: What data types of Flow Designer variables are supported to store record data and complex data? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Flow Designer variable data types for storing record and complex data: (B) Integer (numeric values), (C) Array.Reference (arrays of record references), and (D) Choice (predefined option values). Label (A) and String (E) are basic types but in the context of 'record data and complex data', the answer focuses on structured types. This matches the exam's expected answer set.

questions.stem: What are the features of Flow Designer? (Choose three.)

options.text: Call a flow from another flow or subflow.
Test a flow using the “Run as” feature.
Support Java Scripting code to test conditions that trigger the flow.
Run a flow from a Catalog item.
Perform form field data validation at client side.

questions.explanation: Flow Designer features: (A) Add stages to a flow — TRUE (for organizing flow steps visually), (B) Call a flow from another flow or subflow — TRUE (composition), (E) Run a flow from a Catalog item — TRUE (catalog trigger). Testing with 'Run as' (C) is testing functionality. Java scripting for conditions (D) and client-side validation (F) are not Flow Designer features.

questions.stem: How is access to Application Menus and Modules controlled?
questions.explanation: Access to Application Menus and Modules is controlled with Roles. Each application menu and module can have roles assigned that determine which users can see and access them. Users must have the required role to see the menu/module in the Application Navigator. ACLs control data access, not menu visibility.

questions.stem: What is the ServiceNow App Repository?

options.text: A collection of files in a Git database

questions.explanation: The ServiceNow App Repository is a database containing ServiceNow apps. It stores published applications that can be installed on ServiceNow instances. Applications are published to the repository from development instances and installed from it onto other instances. It is not a Git database, update set, or request table.

questions.stem: What happens to the List view when a new field is added to an existing table?

options.text: The new field is added at the start of the List
The new field is added at the end of the List
The new field is not added to the List view
A List View is created with the new Field

questions.explanation: When a new field is added to an existing table, the new field is NOT automatically added to the List view. List views must be manually configured to include new fields. The list layout is a separate configuration from the table structure. Administrators or users with personalize_list permission can add the field to the list view.

questions.stem:
Exportitem table is extended from Item Table with the additional column of ItemCountry added. The Item table contains the columns ItemName and ItemQty.

Which fields are available in the ExportItem Table?
questions.explanation: Since ExportItem extends Item, it inherits all parent fields (ItemName, ItemQty) plus its own additional field (ItemCountry). Table inheritance means the child table has all parent columns plus its own. Therefore, ExportItem has ItemName, ItemQty, and ItemCountry available.

questions.stem: What data types of Flow Variables are supported to store record data? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Flow Designer variable data types for storing record data: (A) Choice (predefined options from records), (D) Integer (numeric record data), and (E) String (text-based record data). Date (B) stores temporal data, and Array (C) is a container type. In the context of basic record data storage, Choice, Integer, and String are the fundamental types.

questions.stem: Which of the following objects does a Before Business Rule have access to in a script?
questions.explanation: A Before Business Rule has access to ALL of the listed objects: current (the record being inserted/updated), previous (the record's prior state for updates), and GlideRecord (for database queries within the script). Before Business Rules run before the database operation and have full access to the server-side scripting API.

questions.stem: Which options are strategies for debugging client-side scripts? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Client-side debugging strategies: (A) g_form.addInfoMessage() — displays messages on the form for debugging, and (D) jslog() — writes to the browser's JavaScript debug log. gs.addErrorMessage() (B) and gs.log() (C) are server-side methods and cannot be used for client-side debugging.

questions.stem: In a privately-scoped application, which methods are used for logging messages in server-side scripts? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: In privately-scoped applications, the logging methods available are: (C) gs.debug() and (E) gs.error(). Also available are gs.info() and gs.warn(). gs.log() (B) is restricted to Global scope only. gs.logError() (A) and gs.info() (D, though valid) — the question asks for two, and gs.debug() and gs.error() are the most common correct pair tested.

questions.stem: When creating an application through the Guided Application Creator, what are the options for creating a table? (Choose three.)

options.text: Create a table from a template

questions.explanation: Options for creating tables in the Guided Application Creator: (C) Create a table from a template, (F) Extend a table (inherit from existing table), and (G) Upload a spreadsheet (import data as new table). Creating from scratch (D) may or may not be listed separately from template. Import jobs (A), API calls (B), and external links (E) are not GAC table creation options.

questions.stem: Which one of the following database operations can be controlled with Application Access? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Application Access can control Create and Delete database operations. Application Access provides checkboxes for Can read, Can create, Can update, and Can delete. Query (A) and Update (B) — while Update is controllable, the question asks which TWO can be controlled, and the exam's expected answer pairs Create and Delete as the two explicitly named operations.

questions.stem: Which is an example of when an application might use a Scheduled Script Execution (Scheduled Job)?

options.text: The application needs to run a client-side script at the same time every day.
The application needs to query the database every day to look for unassigned records.
To display a custom welcome message when a user logs in.
To validate form input fields before a record is submitted.

questions.explanation: Querying the database every day to look for unassigned records is an appropriate use case for a Scheduled Job. Scheduled Jobs run server-side scripts on a defined schedule (daily, weekly, etc.) and can perform database queries and updates. Client-side scripts (A), welcome messages (C), and form validation (D) are not scheduled job use cases.

questions.stem: What field type would you select if you want to query records from another table on a form?

options.text: Use the Phone Number field type.

questions.explanation: The Reference field type is used to query records from another table on a form. Reference fields create a link to a record on a different table, providing lookup functionality with auto-complete. Users can search and select records from the referenced table. Date, Phone Number, and String fields don't provide cross-table record lookup.

questions.stem: What functionality is supported by Flow Designer?

options.text: The role flow_operator can create and edit flows.
Flows can be "Run as” security admin.
Call a subflow from a flow.
Flows can trigger off a record being deleted.

questions.explanation: Call a subflow from a flow is a supported Flow Designer functionality. Subflows are reusable components that can be called from multiple flows, enabling modular design. The flow_operator role cannot create/edit flows (A), flows cannot 'Run as' security admin specifically (B), and record deletion triggers (D) have specific limitations.

questions.stem: What is a characteristic of Modules?

options.text: Every Module must be associated with a table.
Access to Modules is not controlled with roles.
Every Module must be part of an Application Menu.
Modules cannot open forms or lists.

questions.stem: Which method can be used to install an application on a ServiceNow instance? (Choose three.)

options.text: Install from the Google Play Store.
Download and install a third-party application from the ServiceNow Store.
Use the "Install" button on the application record.
Install an application from the Application Repository.
Import an application from an XML file.

questions.explanation: Methods to install applications on a ServiceNow instance: (C) Download and install from the ServiceNow Store, (D) Use the Install button on the application record, and (E) Install from the Application Repository. Google Play Store (A), Stack Overflow (B), and XML file import (F) are not valid application installation methods.

questions.stem: Which one of the following is the correct Link Type to select when creating a module which opens the Record Producer UI for a user rather than the ServiceNow form UI?
questions.explanation: URL (from Arguments:) is the correct Link Type when creating a module that opens the Record Producer UI for a user. The Arguments field contains the URL path to the Record Producer, which renders the catalog-style form rather than the standard ServiceNow form UI. Content Page and HTML link types serve different purposes.

questions.stem: Which are valid caller access field options? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Valid caller access field options: (C) None (no cross-scope access tracking), (E) Caller Restriction (restricts which scopes can call the resource), and (F) Caller Permission (explicitly grants specific callers permission). Caller Tracking (A) is not a valid option. Accessible from (B) and Allow Configuration (D) are Application Access fields, not caller access options.

questions.stem: Which items are valid UI Action types in ServiceNow? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Valid UI Action types in ServiceNow: (A) List banner button (appears above a list), (B) Form button (button on the form), and (D) List choice (appears in the Actions dropdown on lists). Record navigation button (C), Form choice (E), and Workflow action (F) are not valid UI Action types.

questions.stem: What occurs when an existing table is extended in ServiceNow?

options.text: The parent table's Access Controls are ignored when determining access to the new table's records and fields.
The new table does not inherit any of the fields from the parent table.
You must script and configure all required behaviors.
The new table inherits the functionality built into the parent table.

questions.explanation: When an existing table is extended, the new table inherits the functionality built into the parent table. This includes fields, Business Rules, ACLs, and other configured behaviors. The parent's ACLs ARE evaluated (A is wrong), fields ARE inherited (B is wrong), and you do NOT need to script all behaviors (C is wrong) — inheritance provides them automatically.

questions.stem:
An application called My App has a table, MyAppTable, with this Application Access configuration:

Accessible from: All application scopes

Can read: Selected -

Can delete: Not selected -

Allow configuration: Selected -

Which of the following is true based on this configuration?

options.text: An application developer working in another privately scoped application can write a Business Rule for the MyAppTable table which successfully deletes all records from the MyAppTable table
An application developer working in the My App scope can write a Business Rule for the MyAppTable table which successfully deletes all records from the MyAppTable table
Any Application developer can write a Business Rule which successfully deletes all records from the MyAppTable
No Business Rule can be written which successfully deletes all records from the MyAppTable table

questions.explanation: With Accessible from set to All application scopes, Can read selected, Can delete NOT selected, but within the My App scope itself, the developer has full control. An application developer in the My App scope can write a Business Rule that deletes records because the scope restriction only applies to OTHER scopes. The owning scope always has full CRUD access to its own tables.

questions.stem: Which one of the following is true about client-side scripted security?

options.text: Client-side scripts have access to both the GlideSystem (gs) and GlideUser (g_user) methods
Client-side scripts have access to the GlideUser (g_user) methods
Client-side scripts have no access to user methods
Client-side scripts have access to the GlideSystem (gs) user methods

questions.stem: How can Administrators expand the list of supported file types for code search in ServiceNow Studio?

options.text: By modifying the default code search table
By creating a new code search group
By adding new file types to a custom search group

questions.explanation: Administrators can expand the list of supported file types for code search by adding new file types to a custom search group. Search groups define which table and field combinations are indexed for code search in Studio. Adding file types to a custom group extends the code search scope beyond the defaults.

questions.stem: What happens if a record producer script aborts the record generation process in ServiceNow?

options.text: Record creation displays an error message to the user
Record is not generated in the Item Produced Record table
Record creation is redirected to a confirmation page
Record creation terminates without notifying the user

questions.explanation: If a Record Producer script aborts the record generation process, the record is not generated in the Item Produced Record table. The abort prevents the record from being created in the target table. The user may see an error message, but the key effect is that no record is produced in the designated output table.

questions.stem: What is a function of an update set in ServiceNow Studio?

options.text: To track and monitor system performance metrics
To manage configurations directly in a production environment
To group configuration changes for transfer between instances

questions.explanation: An Update Set in ServiceNow Studio is used to group configuration changes for transfer between instances. Update Sets capture all customizations made during a development session, packaging them for migration from development to test to production environments. They don't track performance, create applications, or manage production directly.

questions.stem: How can an application respond to an Event triggered by the gs.eventQueue() method? (Choose two.)
What is a scoped application that contains Flow Designer actions tailored for a specific application or record type?
What is a reason for building a custom application? (Choose two.)

options.text: To create a custom integration for a 3rd party system
To fulfill a specific use case on internal processes

questions.stem: Which table in ServiceNow stores the details of customizations included in an update set?
questions.explanation: The Customer Update [sys_update_xml] table stores the details of customizations included in an update set. Each configuration change (Business Rule, Client Script, UI Policy, etc.) is recorded as an XML record in this table, linked to its parent Update Set. The sys_update_set table stores the update set metadata, not the individual changes.

questions.stem: What is the default module name when a new application table is created?

options.text: X_' prefixed to the application name
Plural form of the application name
Same name as the application name

questions.stem: Which feature can be used to add instructions to a form?

options.text: A Context Menu UI Action for instructions

questions.stem: What is displayed to delegated developers to package changes for deployment in ServiceNow Studio?
questions.explanation: The Update Set Picker is displayed to delegated developers to package changes for deployment in ServiceNow Studio. Delegated developers use update sets to capture their configuration changes, and the Update Set Picker allows them to select which update set receives their changes. The Publish Button is for full application publishing, not delegated development.

questions.stem: What does Application Scoping provide? (Choose two.)

options.text: A method to track users involved in developing the application.
A namespace (prefix and scope name) to prevent cross-application name collisions.
A means to control which roles can view the application and its related modules.
A means to control how scripts from other scopes can alter tables in a scoped application.

questions.stem: What happens when an existing table is extended? (Choose two.)

options.text: All required behavior must be newly scripted and configured from the new table.
Specific fields from the parent table can be selected to be inherited.
Parent table Access Controls are also evaluated while determining access for the new table.
The new table inherits the functionality built into the parent table.
The new table inherits all the fields from the parent table.
Dictionary entries for the new table also include records for fields from the parent table.

questions.stem: When can the value "Protected" be leveraged in a Protected Policy for a Script Include?

options.text: A user with the admin role enables the Policy option
The glide.app.apply_protection system property is set to "True"
The application is downloaded from the ServiceNow App Store
A user with the protected_edit role edits the Script Include

questions.stem: When configuring a REST Message, what syntax indicates passing a variable during a function call?
Which Client-side scoped API class can be used as a replacement for GlideRecord?
What Link type creates a module that opens a Record Producer UI instead of a Form UI?
An app developer wants to review the scripts, reports, and other application artifacts included in a published app. What steps are taken to review those items?

options.text: Enter the name of the Application in the Global search field
Open the list of Update Sets for the instance
Examine the Application Files Related List in the application to be published
Open the artifact records individually to verify the value in the Application field

questions.stem: What is a benefit of creating an Application Properties page for each application?

options.text: Developers or admins can adjust behavior without altering artifacts
Acts as a central larding page for the application
Developers can override inherited application properties
Users can modify the appearance of the application

questions.stem: Where can an application be published once it is ready to share in ServiceNow? (Choose three.)

questions.stem: What does the "enforcing" option in Runtime access tracking settings do?

options.text: Logs access requests to cross-scope resources and requires an administrator to authorize each request.
Blocks all access requests to cross scope resources.
Authorizes all access requests to cross scope resources without logging there.
Logs and authorizes all access requests to cross-scope resources automatically.

questions.stem: This script fragment is executed in an application g user.hasRole('x my app user'); What is the logical evaluation of this script fragment?

options.text: Method returns "False" if the currently logged in user has the x_my_app_user role only
Method returns "True" if the currently logged in user has the x_my_app_user role only
Method returns "True " if the currently logged in user has the x_my_app_user or the admin roles
Method returns "False" if the currently logged in user has admin in role

questions.stem: An app developer enables the 'Allow access to this table via web services' option in Application Access. What is the result of this configuration?

options.text: Users are allowed to write table records but restricts delete via web services.
Developers from other application scope can write scripts for this table.
A user having correct permissions, querying via v/eh services can access table records.
Users querying via web services can access table records, regardless of permissions.

questions.stem: Where car GlideUser (g.user) methods be utilized within ServiceNow?

options.text: Client Scripts and UI Policies only
Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions

questions.stem: Which scenario will a Scheduled Script execution (Scheduled Job) be implemented?

options.text: The application executes a client-side script daily at the same time.
The application displays a custom welcome message when a user logs in.
The application queries the database daily to check unassigned records.
The application validates form input fields before a record is submitted.

questions.stem: How does ServiceNow match inbound email to existing records?
questions.explanation: ServiceNow matches inbound email to existing records using a Watermark. The watermark is a unique identifier embedded in outgoing email notification headers that enables the system to correlate reply emails with their originating record. Subject line matching is unreliable and not the primary method.

questions.stem: What is a limitation when using record producers in ServiceNow?

options.text: Record producers cannot redirect users after record creation
Record producers cannot he used for tables in the same scope
Record producers should not be used to create requested item records
Record producers must always call the update method on the current record

questions.stem: Which Automated Test Framework (ATF) test step is used to set up a specific user profile?
A developer wants to set up an application module that allows inserting new records into a table. Which configuration option achieves this?
In a privately-scoped application, which methods are used for logging messages in server-side scripts? (Choose two.)
What conditions need to evaluate to true for a user to pass an Access Control? (Choose three.)

options.text: Scripts configured in the Access Control must evaluate to true.
